title: Krawtchouk Polynomial Evaluation
statement: Let $n,z,j$ be nonnegative integers with $z\le n$, and let $K_{n,j}$ be the Krawtchouk polynomial. Its value at $z$ is the coefficient of $X^j$ in $(1-X)^z(1+X)^{n-z}$: $K_{n,j}(z)=[X^j](1-X)^z(1+X)^{n-z}$.
